title: Babymoon Belly Balm

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Body Lotions & Body Oils > Body Moisturizers > Bath & Body

descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Vegan✓ Good for: Loss of firmness✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Best for Dry, Combo, Normal Skin
What it is: A velvety body balm created by an expectant mother that melts into skin to boost suppleness and elasticity on contact.

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Natural Oil Blend: Sunflower seed and avocado oils support collagen synthesis and barrier repair.
- Vitamin E: This antioxidant vitamin is known to encourage healing and boost elasticity.
- Calendula Oil: Helps soothe and improve the comfort of stressed or overstretched skin.

What Else You Need to Know: Its 100 percent water-free, vegan formula contains only pregnancy-safe ingredients, including nourishing sunflower, avocado, and olive oils and a soothing, all-natural calendula scent. Super-concentrated for maximum moisture, it's ideal for dry, overstretched skin.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Massage into skin wherever extra-nourishing moisture and comfort are needed.
-If pregnant, use morning and night for deep, soothing hydration.

For best results, please store in a cool place (below 85° F/30° C). If your Babymoon Belly Balm does not gently squeeze out of the tube, we recommend running the tube under warm water for easy application.
Ingredients+
-Natural Oil Blend: Sunflower seed and avocado oils support collagen synthesis and barrier repair.
-Vitamin E: This antioxidant vitamin is known to encourage healing and boost elasticity.
-Calendula Oil: Helps soothe and improve the comfort of stressed or overstretched skin.

Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil, Synthetic Wax, Tocopheryl Acetate, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Calendula Officinalis Flower Oil, Rosa Damascena Flower Oil, Lavandula Angustifolia (Lavender) Oil, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Orange) Flower Oil, Linalool.



The list of ingredients is subject to change, please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
